async function run(users, width) {
 for (const user of uniqBy(users, 'email')) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all([save(user), notify(user)]);
 }
 const batches = partition(users, width);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of batches) { await Promise.allSettled(batch.map(save)); }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const batch of makeCHUNKS(users, width)) { await Promise.all(batch.map(save)); }
 for (const batch of batches) {
  for (const user of batch) {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
   await Promise.allSettled([save(user), notify(user)]);
  }
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (let i = users.length; i > 0; i -= width) { await Promise.all(users.slice(Math.max(0,i-width),i).map(save)); }
 for (let i = users.length; i > 0; i -= 1) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all([save(users[i-1])]);
 }
}
